rebuttals.topic: P1 residual: va 3 dong re-check status duoi lock, hay bo?
rebuttals.myRound1Position: Va 3 dong re-check status duoi lock (migration moi), uu tien thap nhat, defer duoc.
rebuttals.evidence: supabase/migrations/20260529120000_doubles_elimination_open_registration.sql:215 — close_doubles_elimination_registration KHONG co pg_advisory_xact_lock (grep 0 hit trong file)
rebuttals.note: Du kien 'close unlocked' em CO o vong 1 (muc 'Dieu em khong chac': cancel/close khong lock), nhung em rut ket luan SAI khi noi 3 dong 'dong dung invariant DB-01'. Tu mo :215 xac nhan close khong lay lock → 3 dong chi THU HEP cua so (con lai khe close-commit-giua-status-read-va-insert), khong GUARANTEE dong. Mot mitigation khong dam bao, tren mot CREATE OR REPLACE live cua register RPC (downside SLO-3 neu than ham sai) > residual 1 doi seed=NULL hoi phuc duoc. Refine: bo P1 khoi goi nay; neu lam thi lam DUNG (lock ca close+cancel) trong mot DB release co test rieng, khong phai follow-up 3 dong. Trung khuyen nghi risk-auditor.
